connector.name: VIES Smoother
connector.registryDescription: SLA'd EU VAT validation on VIES. Honest 3-state result, never guesses. 100 free lookups.
connector.summary: Hosted at vantane.com over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the lucrumist account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: API key claimed via POST https://vantane.com/keys/claim (free, no account needed, 100 free lookups). Each caller must use their own key -- this is a shared public endpoint with per-key metering.
